sections.skill: Explain training, validation and test data

questions.prompt: What is the training set used for?

choices.text: Advertising the model to customers
Comparing versions during development
The final check
The examples the model learns from

questions.correct_answer: The examples the model learns from
questions.intro: Builders usually split their data into three parts. The TRAINING SET is what the model learns from. The VALIDATION SET is used during development to compare versions and settings, like practice quizzes. The TEST SET is kept aside and used only at the end to measure how well the finished model does on examples it has never seen. If test examples leak into training, the test score looks better than the model really is, because the model may have learned those exact answers. A trustworthy result comes from examples that stayed unseen.
questions.feedback: The model learns from the training set.

sections.skill: Compare studying, practice quizzes and a final exam

questions.prompt: The textbook is like which data set?

choices.text: The training set
The validation set
The test set
No data set

questions.correct_answer: The training set
questions.intro: A student preparing for a final exam studies from a TEXTBOOK, takes PRACTICE QUIZZES to see what still needs work, and then takes the FINAL EXAM. The exam is useful only if its questions are new. If the student saw the exact exam questions in advance, a high score would show memory, not real understanding. Model data works the same way: the training set is the textbook, the validation set is the practice quizzes, and the test set is the final exam that must stay secret until the end.
questions.feedback: The model learns from the training set.

sections.title: Apply it

sections.skill: Spot hidden problems with test data

questions.prompt: The same news story appears on two websites. One copy is in training, the other in the test set. What is the risk?

choices.text: The model will refuse to read news
The test becomes harder than real use
None, because the websites have different names
The test includes something the model has already seen

questions.correct_answer: The test includes something the model has already seen
questions.intro: Keeping test data truly separate is harder than it sounds. Copies of the same item can appear twice, for example the same photo cropped slightly, or the same news story on two websites, so one copy lands in training and another in the test. Reusing the test set again and again to choose between versions also wears it out: the team slowly tunes the model to that particular test. And a test set that does not look like real use, such as clear studio photos when users will upload blurry phone pictures, gives a score that does not predict real performance.
questions.feedback: Near-duplicates can leak test content into training.

questions.prompt: A team checks its test score after every small change for months. What problem can this cause?

The model forgets its training data
